# apfsctl v0.2.0-beta.6

This beta makes the guided setup reconcile APFS volume settings when the same volume name is used again.

- The setup assistant asks whether the volume should be visible in Finder and whether to keep, enable, or disable Spotlight indexing and persistent FSEvents logging.
- Re-running setup or `create` with the same volume identity applies requested settings without creating a duplicate volume.
- Finder visibility changes are applied by safely unmounting and remounting the volume, and the persistent `fstab` entry is updated to match.
- The explicit `create` command accepts `--visibility`, `--spotlight`, and `--fsevents`; `configure` can reconcile the same policies.
- Encryption remains mandatory. Existing passphrases are preserved; changing one is not part of this release.
- Completion dialogs report whether the volume was created or already existed and summarize the resulting settings.

**Beta:** Privileged APFS operations and reboot behavior still need validation on physical macOS devices. Use a disposable volume and keep a backup. Encrypted volumes need to be unlocked after restart. Binaries are unsigned and not notarized.
